text:
Priya N: quick heads-up — SkyBridge SB-X3 preview request landed. They want a mini EAP: connector + perf pass + marketplace packaging. Main blockers: NDA turnaround, SI test harness, and embargo timing.
Ben T: NDA — are they ok with our standard EAP NDA? If not, legal will need sample counters.
Kumar R: From runtime bench POV we need: model candidate, sequence length, target SKU, and expected baseline. propose: model=mistral-7b-v1, seq=2048, batches=1,8; metrics: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, GPU mem, power if available.
Nora L: Packaging note — partner marketplace demands image digests + SBOM + chart. Also need a short operator guide for SI to run in their lab. I can draft the guide.
partner-ops-bot: Upload complete 2021-04-022020: NDA_template_eap_sb-v2.pdf at https://redwood.internal/legal/NDA_SB_v2.pdf
Priya N: Ben, can you confirm NDA path? SkyBridge legal asked for 5 business days for review. If they push redlines we'll need to fast-track.
Ben T: I'll ping legal now. Tentative SLA: review window <= 3 business days if we give our redlines within 24h.
Kumar R: For bench harness, prefer we give them a containerized runner and a small dataset (50 prompts) to run locally so results are reproducible. Script example:
```bash
docker run --rm -v $(pwd)/prompts:/prompts redwood/bench-runner:stable \
  --model mistral-7b-v1 --seq 2048 --batch 1 --repeats 2 \
  --tags partner=skybridge,pilot=sbx3,run=SBX-01
```
Kumar R: Require two repeats per config; we'll average and report standard deviation. Also add an env var REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_KEY so runs map back to our telemetry (we'll issue keys per partner).
Nora L: Marketplace checklist (early): image + digest, Helm chart, values.example.yaml, LICENSE, SBOM, quickstart README, marketplace metadata (short desc + 3 bullets). I'll scaffold this repo and open PR.
Priya N: Proposal timeline (draft):
- NDA signed: 2026-04-02
- Lab creds + telemetry keys issued: 2026-04-06
- Bench runner & prompts posted: 2026-04-08
- First blind perf report (no logos): 2026-04-18
- Marketplace package ready: 2026-04-20
- Embargoed announce target: 2026-04-25
Ben T: Marketing request: provide a short placeholder blurb for partner comms before we share perf numbers. I can draft and send to SkyBridge coms.
Kumar R: Acceptance criteria idea: p95 < 250ms on batch=1 on target SKU (A100-80GB), throughput >= our internal baseline for mistral-7b-v1. If target fails, fallback to 4-bit quant variant and record delta in report.
Nora L: SI handoff — who owns the field engineer kit? We need a runbook, ssh jumpbox creds (ephemeral), and a contact on their side. Recommend we schedule a 1-hr lab onboarding with their infra lead before runs.
Priya N: Ownership: NDA/Ben, runtime harness/Kumar, packaging/Nora, partner comms/Priya. Action items: everyone drop calendar availability for a 30m sync tomorrow (Priya will schedule).
Ben T: I'll confirm NDA status by EOD.
Kumar R: I'll start the bench runner container and push prompts. Will include monitoring hooks for p95 and GPU utilization.
Nora L: Opening PR for marketplace scaffold now, will tag @priya for review.
partner-ops-bot: Reminder : Please ensure SBOM policy v1.3 met. Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/sbom-policy
Priya N: Thanks all. If no major objections I'll treat the timeline above as canonical and update the partnerships tracker. :rocket:
